scope: Proposition 8.1 of the manuscript “Contact Fano manifolds and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture” (preprints/Contact-Fano-manifolds-and-the-LeBrun-Salamon-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 062 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c7ef1ec44ffd8d7a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, F) be a smooth connected complex projective contact manifold with ample contact line L. Suppose a connected algebraic group G acts effectively and transitively on X, preserving F. Then g = Lie(G) is simple, and contact values of fundamental vector fields define an isomorphism Φ : (X, F) ∼ − − → (︁ P(Omin(g)), Fcan )︁ . Under this isomorphism, L is the restriction of the hyperplane line bundle of P(g).
